patches.name: Network Optimizations
patches.description: Improves Steam Link 2.0.23's streaming transport: a loss burst large enough to overflow the retransmission-request buffer now re-requests the accumulated missing packets instead of aborting the stream, the frame-reorder (backtrack) window widens from 6 to 12 frames, a momentarily-starving decoder keeps its buffered frames instead of flushing them, and the UDP send buffer for retransmission requests grows from 128 KiB to 1 MiB. No bitrate, resolution or quality setting is changed. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset validation pending.

options.title: Calibration profile
options.description: Selects gamma and saturation for both layers when the VD options are off, or for the base layer when a VD foveal option is on.

options.title: Gamma
options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.

options.title: Saturation
options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.

options.title: Fovea VD-like SDR processing
options.description: VD-informed SDR foveal processing: highp sampling, Valve's decoder colour correction retained, the calibration profile bypassed on the foveal layer, and no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. The former 10-bit and 8-bit variants selected the same processing and are now one toggle. Does not negotiate host depth or reproduce VD's raw-YUV decoder import. Turn off when blue-noise dithering is selected on the foveal layer.

options.title: Foveal gamma adjustment
options.description: Additional gamma on the foveal layer only, after its colour processing. 1.00 leaves it unchanged; higher values darken shadows and midtones. Try 1.02 first for a lighter foveal region. Works with either VD option or both off, before fade and optional blue-noise dithering. Background calibration and edge blending stay unchanged; this is manual compensation, not a verified seam fix.

patches.name: OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST
patches.description: Requests the OpenXR BOOST performance hint for CPU and GPU on each session start. The runtime still controls clocks and thermal limits. Unsupported runtimes continue without BOOST. Adds an APK-local API layer; no root required. All repository-supported Steam Link builds; runtime performance benefit is not yet measured.
